title: Commit and push

summary:
Sent when you press Commit and push in the pull request strip. The agent writes the commit message, not Bloom.

variables:
- workspace: The workspace's name.
- branch: The branch the work is on.
- base_branch: The branch the pull request targets.
- changes: The changed files, with their added and removed line counts.

template:
Commit everything outstanding in this worktree, with a message that describes the change the way this project words one, then push {{branch}} so its pull request reflects what is here. If there is nothing to commit, just push.
